primary: code copied from the A/D column

themes.theme: code copied from the A/D column
themes.root_cause: The transaction code is filled with the row's acquired/disposed letter (A or D) instead of the code column; both are single letters and A/D are valid codes, so validation cannot catch it.
A holdings line (no date, no code) is reported as a transaction.
A field holds a number that belongs to a different column of the same row (a column shift).
